results.title: 3 Non-Tech Stocks Still Winning Big on AI
results.author: Nathan Reiff
results.description: Three non-tech companies are capitalizing on AI-driven data center demand: Powell Industries (POWL) designs power control systems with a massive $1.8B backlog; AAON (AAON) provides critical HVAC cooling solutions with record sales up 54% YOY; and EMCOR Group (EME) offers broad electrical/mechanical contracting services with strong revenue growth and analyst optimism. All three offer diversified AI exposure beyond traditional tech stocks.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong backlog of $1.8B (up 33% YOY), significant data center projects exceeding $400M, and sustainable capacity expansion. However, stock has already rallied 120% YTD with a P/E of 45, suggesting valuation concerns despite analyst Buy ratings.

Record quarterly sales of $497M (up 54% YOY), backlog doubled to $2.1B, and full-year guidance of 40-45% sales growth. Stock up 48% YTD with four Buy ratings, though analysts see minimal additional upside potential.

Nearly 20% YOY revenue growth to $4.63B, 30% YOY EPS improvement, and strong full-year guidance of $18.5-19.3B revenue. Stock up 27% YTD with nine Buy ratings and 12% additional upside potential according to analysts.

results.title: Nasdaq 100 Climbs Records, Oil Extends Drop As Iran Weighs Hormuz Deal: Stock Market Today
results.author: Piero Cingari
results.description: U.S. tech stocks reached record highs on May 7, 2026, as crude oil tumbled nearly 3% on hopes Iran will accept a U.S. memorandum to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Nasdaq 100 gained 0.4% to 28,706 while the S&P 500 rose 0.2% to 7,376. Earnings drove significant stock-specific moves, with major winners including AAON (+36%), Datadog (+30%), and H&R Block (+26%), while notable losers included Planet Fitness (-33%), Insmed (-22%), and Zoetis (-22%).
